# Stack48 Admin UI

> Presentational React + shadcn/ui kit for Stack48 internal ops dashboards. Consumed as a git dependency (`github:121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit#vX.Y.Z`), not from npm. Visual source of truth: gtm.stack48.com (Inter 13px, zinc canvas, blue-500 brand, 2px radii).

The kit is presentational only. Pass data via props. No Supabase, Resend, fetching, or business logic.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/README.md): git install, Tailwind preset, styles.css, first `cn()` usage
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/AGENTS.md): install, theme, import map, compose folders, house style rules, token names
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md): every component PR ships docs, stories, TSDoc, changeset
- [ADOPTION](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/docs/ADOPTION.md): migrating apps (GTM dashboard and others) onto the kit
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): semver via changesets; tags are vX.Y.Z GitHub Releases, no registry publish

## Code

- [src/tokens.ts](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/src/tokens.ts): JS token map (zinc, brand, semantic HSL, radii, type, spacing, layout)
- [src/styles/theme.css](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/src/styles/theme.css): shadcn CSS variables (`:root` and `.dark`)
- [src/styles/styles.css](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/src/styles/styles.css): public stylesheet (fonts + variables + GTM body)
- [src/preset.ts](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/src/preset.ts): Tailwind v3 preset
- [src/lib/cn.ts](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/src/lib/cn.ts): `cn()` helper
- [src/primitives](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/tree/main/src/primitives): customised shadcn (Button, Input, Dialog, Select, …)
- [src/admin](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/tree/main/src/admin): AppShell, Sidebar, PageHeader, DataTable
- [src/charts](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/tree/main/src/charts): KPI strip/tiles, dense metrics header, sparklines, activity/reputation charts, stacked bars, funnels, schematic world map
- [src/inbox](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/tree/main/src/inbox): Gmail-style inbox (InboxLayout, FolderList, MessageList, ThreadView, MessageMeta, SandboxedHtml, useInboxKeyboard)
- [src/states](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/tree/main/src/states): EmptyState, LoadingState, ErrorState, InlineAlert, ConfirmDialog, MultiEmailModal, ScheduleEditor, SendingIdentityEditor

## Imports

```
@stack48/admin-ui                 cn, tokens, preset
@stack48/admin-ui/tokens          token objects
@stack48/admin-ui/preset          Tailwind preset + adminUiContentGlobs
@stack48/admin-ui/cn              cn()
@stack48/admin-ui/styles.css      public CSS
@stack48/admin-ui/theme.css       CSS variables only
@stack48/admin-ui/primitives      Button, Input, Dialog, Select, …
@stack48/admin-ui/admin           AppShell, Sidebar, PageHeader, DataTable
@stack48/admin-ui/charts          KPI strip, sparklines, funnels, trends, world map
@stack48/admin-ui/inbox           InboxLayout, FolderList, MessageList, ThreadView, MessageMeta, SandboxedHtml, useInboxKeyboard
@stack48/admin-ui/states          EmptyState, LoadingState, ErrorState, InlineAlert, ConfirmDialog, MultiEmailModal, ScheduleEditor, SendingIdentityEditor
@stack48/admin-ui/components/*    same namespaces via the components/* export map
```

## House style (non-negotiable)

Professional ops tool. Dense. Full-width layouts. No boxy cartoon cards. Data via props. Presentational only.

`--primary` is zinc-900. `--brand` / `--ring` is blue-500 (GTM `--accent`). `--radius` is 0.125rem.
